overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated performance metrics shows a clear dominance by extreme space scenarios ('What If You Fell Into...' format) and bizarre planetary physics, generating the highest views-per-day, likes-per-view, and engagement ratios. Recent 7-day uploads (late September to early October 2026) significantly outperform older entries, proving that audience appetite strongly favors immersive, high-stakes hypothetical astronomy over general psychology or static animal facts.
